title: Membrane form-finding from an input mesh (Theory II)
description_for_llm: Second-order (AnalyseThII) solve of a prestressed membrane built from an input mesh with a soft membrane material - reports the equilibrium (form-found) state. Use for tent / sail / canopy membranes anchored at points. ALMOND_IN_PRESTRAIN is the Eps0 pre-strain fed to the template's prestress load (dimensionless; the original slider used ~0.005-0.01); vertex loads from the template's VertexLoads cluster now act on the INPUT mesh. The displacement output is the form-finding movement of the membrane, NOT a serviceability deflection - validate_structure's L/250 check is not meaningful for this capsule; read the numbers directly via run_gh_definition. HARNESSED 2026-08-30 from 04_MembraneFormFinding.ghx. VERIFIED 2026-08-30: 9x9 m hypar mesh (4x4 faces), 4 corner anchors, prestrain 0.005 -> form-finding movement 3.49 m, mass 76 kg.

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_MESH
inputs.description: Initial membrane mesh in metres (breps are meshed by the runner). Keep under the Karamba trial's shell-element cap (about 5x5 faces) on a trial license.

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_PRESTRAIN
inputs.description: Pre-strain (Eps0) for the membrane prestress load; dimensionless.

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_SUPPORTS
inputs.description: Support node positions. When omitted the validator supplies the lowest-Z nodes of the input members automatically.

outputs.name: ALMOND_OUT_DISP_MM
outputs.description: Largest nodal displacement; Karamba emits centimetres, converted downstream per these units.

outputs.name: ALMOND_OUT_MASS_KG
outputs.description: Total structural mass of the model.
